📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 boundary：high.滚动窗口(20).max().shift(1)
  2. 计算 recent_breakout：(close > boundary).astype(float).滚动窗口(5).max().shift(1)
  3. 计算 retest_depth：(1.0 - ((low - boundary) / boundary).abs()).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
  4. 计算 vol_ratio：volume / volume.滚动窗口(20).mean()
  5. 计算 narrow_bar：1.0 / (1.0 + (high - low) / close)
  6. 计算 participation：(1.0 / (1.0 + vol_ratio)) * narrow_bar
  7. 计算 day_range：(high - low)
  8. 计算 settlement_premium：pd.Series(
  9. 计算 index：df_copy.index
  10. 计算 score：recent_breakout * retest_depth * participation * settlement_premium

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. max(0, 1 - |low-B|/B) — max(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大
  2. MA20(V) — MA20(x) → 20 期移动均线
  3. max(high) — max(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大
  4. shift(1) — shift(n) → 滞后/移位

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_retest_settlement_premium_20_5(df): """Idea: Genuine post-breakout level-hold requires a shallow retest of the broken 20-day high with shrinking participation, ">class="kw">and the close settling well above the boundary relative to the day's range confirms the hold. Logic: The boundary is the prior 20-day high shifted one day. A recent breakout state is active when any close exceeded the boundary "kw">class="kw">in the prior five days. Retest depth peaks when today"str">'s low is near the boundary. Participation quality rewards volume contraction "kw">class="kw">and narrow bars. The settlement premium "kw">class="kw">from the first parent replaces a binary close-above flag: it measures how far the close finishes above the boundary "kw">class="kw">in units of the day's range. The product of breakout state, retest depth, participation quality, "kw">class="kw">and settlement premium is averaged over five days "kw">class="kw">for durability. Formula: S = mean_5( I[prior 5d breakout] * max(0, 1 - |low-B|/B) * (1/(1+V/MA20(V))) * (1/(1+(H-L)/close)) * I[close>B] * (close-B)/(H-L) ), B = rolling20(max(high)).shift(1) Sub-mechanism tags: range_boundary_retest, settlement_premium, volume_contraction, breakout_hold """ df_copy = df.copy() boundary = df_copy["high"].rolling(20).max().shift(1) recent_breakout = (df_copy["close"] > boundary).astype(float).rolling(5).max().shift(1) retest_depth = (1.0 - ((df_copy["low"] - boundary) / boundary).abs()).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0) vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / df_copy["volume"].rolling(20).mean() narrow_bar = 1.0 / (1.0 + (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"]) participation = (1.0 / (1.0 + vol_ratio)) * narrow_bar day_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).replace(0.0, np.nan) settlement_premium = pd.Series( np.where(df_copy["close"] > boundary, (df_copy["close"] - boundary) / day_range, 0.0), index=df_copy.index ) score = recent_breakout * retest_depth * participation * settlement_premium df_copy["factor_retest_settlement_premium_20_5"] = pd.Series(score, index=df_copy.index).rolling(5).mean() "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_retest_settlement_premium_20_5"]
